sn12.21:1.2: This discourse (and the next) simply plonk down a series of teachings without connecting them in any way. | The ten powers (of a Realized One) are explained at [mn12:9.1](), where they are followed by the four kinds of self-assurance ([mn12:22.1]()). The powers are found independently at [an10.21]() and [an10.22](), and the four kinds of self-assurance at [an4.8](). | The “divine wheel” (_brahmacakka_) is a synonym for the “wheel of the teaching” (_dhammacakka_). In Śvetāśvatara Upaniṣad 1.6, the same term refers to the circle of existence in which all things live.
